user.title: Connect to DiodeLED DMX Controller
user.description: Enter the network details for your DiodeLED DMX Controller.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the DiodeLED DMX controller on your local network.
data_description.port: TCP port used by the controller (default is 8899).
data_description.name: Friendly name for the controller's device in Home Assistant.

discovery_confirm.title: Discovered DiodeLED DMX Controller
discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to add the DiodeLED DMX Controller at {host} to Home Assistant?

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure DiodeLED DMX Controller
reconfigure.description: Update the network details if the controller's IP address or port changed.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the DiodeLED DMX controller on your local network.
data_description.port: TCP port used by the controller (default is 8899).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the controller. Check the IP address and port, and close the TouchDial mobile app (the controller accepts only one connection at a time).

init.title: Controller zones
init.description: Select the zones that have lights connected. Each selected zone gets its own light and rainbow speed entities. Only zone 1 has been verified on hardware.
